structure.raw_value: BoWoCl>.Cool? Not the word I’d use.

translation: Odjazdowe? To nie jest słowo, którego bym użył.

source_text: Everyone, stay near the rift. If any monster tries to attack you, go through it.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx^.Everyone, stay near the rift. If any monster tries to attack you, go through it.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx^.Everyone, stay near the rift. If any monster tries to attack you, go through it."

translation: Wszyscy trzymajcie się blisko szczeliny. Jeśli zaatakuje was jakiś potwór, przejdźcie przez nią.

source_text: What about the mansion? Isn’t it collapsing?

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl.What about the mansion? Isn’t it collapsing?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl.What about the mansion? Isn’t it collapsing?"

translation: A co z rezydencją? Przecież się wali, prawda?

source_text: You’re better off dying on Earth than being trapped here.

structure.raw_value: BrWoEx^.You’re better off dying on Earth than being trapped here.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoEx^.You’re better off dying on Earth than being trapped here."

translation: Lepiej zginąć na Ziemi niż utknąć tutaj.

source_text: Bobby… You and your men keep an eye on the girls.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Bobby… You and your men keep an eye on the girls.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Bobby… You and your men keep an eye on the girls."

translation: Bobby… Ty i twoi ludzie miejcie oko na dziewczyny.

source_text: Father… We should find Erica… If she’s here.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Father… We should find Erica… If she’s here.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Father… We should find Erica… If she’s here."

translation: Ojcze… Powinniśmy znaleźć Ericę… jeśli tu jest.

source_text: Go to the altar… I will find the Toma.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx^.Go to the altar… I will find the Toma.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx^.Go to the altar… I will find the Toma."

translation: Idź do ołtarza… Ja znajdę Tomę.

source_text: Shouldn’t you have help?

structure.raw_value: AdWoOp^.Shouldn’t you have help?

translation: Nie powinieneś wziąć kogoś do pomocy?

source_text: A couple of treasure hunters could come in handy…

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx^.A couple of treasure hunters could come in handy…
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx^.A couple of treasure hunters could come in handy…"

translation: Kilku łowców skarbów mogłoby się przydać…

source_text: Henry and Diana… Care to accompany me?

structure.raw_value: BrFrOp^.Henry and Diana… Care to accompany me?
structure.script_literal: "BrFrOp^.Henry and Diana… Care to accompany me?"

source_text: I’ll do what I can.

structure.raw_value: HrBaOp.I’ll do what I can.

source_text: Why not… Seems like a fine way to die.

structure.raw_value: DiBaDe^.Why not… Seems like a fine way to die.
structure.script_literal: "DiBaDe^.Why not… Seems like a fine way to die."

translation: Czemu nie… To chyba niezły sposób na śmierć.

source_text: I’m coming with you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: NeBaEx^.I’m coming with you, 1Hero.

source_text: Let’s save Erica.

structure.raw_value: ElFrEx.Let’s save Erica.

source_text: I’m going with Dad.

structure.raw_value: TaBaOp.I’m going with Dad.

source_text: Stay put, young lady.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx^.Stay put, young lady.

source_text: Keep an eye on the rift, Tasha. It’s on you to fuck up Lillian if she causes trouble.

structure.raw_value: BrAnEx^.Keep an eye on the rift, Tasha. It’s on you to fuck up Lillian if she causes trouble.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnEx^.Keep an eye on the rift, Tasha. It’s on you to fuck up Lillian if she causes trouble."

translation: Miej oko na szczelinę, Tasha. Jeśli Lillian zacznie sprawiać kłopoty, masz ją rozwalić.

source_text: If Lilith gives us any trouble, I’ll shoot her.

structure.raw_value: TaFlEx.If Lilith gives us any trouble, I’ll shoot her.
structure.script_literal: "TaFlEx.If Lilith gives us any trouble, I’ll shoot her."

translation: Jeśli Lilith będzie sprawiać kłopoty, zastrzelę ją.

source_text: But we’re already in Hell… I don’t know what will happen.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.But we’re already in Hell… I don’t know what will happen.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.But we’re already in Hell… I don’t know what will happen."

translation: Ale jesteśmy już w Piekle… Nie wiem, co się stanie.

source_text: Who cares? I’ll still shoot her.

structure.raw_value: TaFlDe.Who cares? I’ll still shoot her.

translation: Kogo to obchodzi? I tak ją zastrzelę.

source_text: Are we going to get attacked or not? I can’t stand waiting.

structure.raw_value: ObWoCl.Are we going to get attacked or not? I can’t stand waiting.
structure.script_literal: "ObWoCl.Are we going to get attacked or not? I can’t stand waiting."

translation: Zaatakują nas w końcu, czy nie? Nie znoszę czekać.

source_text: Rinaldi wants us going back into the mansion... I don't know which is worse, here or there.

structure.raw_value: ObWoCl.Rinaldi wants us going back into the mansion... I don't know which is worse, here or there.
structure.script_literal: "ObWoCl.Rinaldi wants us going back into the mansion... I don't know which is worse, here or there."

translation: Rinaldi chce, żebyśmy wrócili do rezydencji… Nie wiem, co gorsze: tam czy tutaj.

source_text: I don’t want to die here.

structure.raw_value: OaWoCl.I don’t want to die here.

source_text: We'll check on the mansion and make sure it's safe before we let the girls leave.

structure.raw_value: OaWoCl.We'll check on the mansion and make sure it's safe before we let the girls leave.
structure.script_literal: "OaWoCl.We'll check on the mansion and make sure it's safe before we let the girls leave."

translation: Sprawdzimy rezydencję i upewnimy się, że jest bezpieczna, zanim pozwolimy dziewczynom wyjść.

source_text: I take it that Erica is safe.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.I take it that Erica is safe.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.I take it that Erica is safe."

source_text: We’re just waiting for Lilith.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.We’re just waiting for Lilith.

source_text: Is this Hell? It can’t be… right?

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl.Is this Hell? It can’t be… right?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl.Is this Hell? It can’t be… right?"

translation: Czy to Piekło? To niemożliwe… prawda?

source_text: This is the most terrifying place I’ve ever seen!

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl.This is the most terrifying place I’ve ever seen!
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl.This is the most terrifying place I’ve ever seen!"

translation: To najbardziej przerażające miejsce, jakie widziałam!

source_text: You think they have farms in Hell? What would they farm?

structure.raw_value: HnFrOp.You think they have farms in Hell? What would they farm?
structure.script_literal: "HnFrOp.You think they have farms in Hell? What would they farm?"

translation: Myślisz, że w Piekle są farmy? Co mogliby tam uprawiać?

source_text: That bomb looks dangerous… This whole place looks dangerous.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.That bomb looks dangerous… This whole place looks dangerous.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.That bomb looks dangerous… This whole place looks dangerous."

translation: Ta bomba wygląda groźnie… Całe to miejsce jest niebezpieczne.

source_text: The mansion is collapsing. We have to be careful.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.The mansion is collapsing. We have to be careful.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.The mansion is collapsing. We have to be careful."

source_text: Canmore? Rinaldi?

structure.raw_value: OaWoOp^.Canmore? Rinaldi?

source_text: What’s the status?

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp.What’s the status?

source_text: Is the mansion safe?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Is the mansion safe?

source_text: It appears to have stabilized… The earthquakes are gone.

structure.raw_value: OaWoEx^.It appears to have stabilized… The earthquakes are gone.
structure.script_literal: "OaWoEx^.It appears to have stabilized… The earthquakes are gone."

translation: Wygląda na to, że się ustabilizowała… Trzęsienia ziemi ustały.

source_text: Everyone, back to the mansion!

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Everyone, back to the mansion!

source_text: We’re not done here.

structure.raw_value: HrBaOp^.We’re not done here.

source_text: I’ll find Erica. Everyone else, go inside.

structure.raw_value: McBeEx.I’ll find Erica. Everyone else, go inside.
structure.script_literal: "McBeEx.I’ll find Erica. Everyone else, go inside."

source_text: Diana… Make sure Duncan doesn’t escape. I’m going with 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx^.Diana… Make sure Duncan doesn’t escape. I’m going with 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaEx^.Diana… Make sure Duncan doesn’t escape. I’m going with 1Hero."

translation: Diana… Dopilnuj, żeby Duncan nie uciekł. Idę z 1Hero.

source_text: Don’t die for this, Henry.

structure.raw_value: DiAnOp.Don’t die for this, Henry.

source_text: I’m going with 1Hero too!

structure.raw_value: HnAnEx^.I’m going with 1Hero too!

source_text: Oh no, you’re not!

structure.raw_value: CaAnOp.Oh no, you’re not!

source_text: Come on, everyone! We have to go!

structure.raw_value: OaWoEx^.Come on, everyone! We have to go!
structure.script_literal: "OaWoEx^.Come on, everyone! We have to go!"

source_text: Lillian?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Lillian?

source_text: She’s hurt.

structure.raw_value: NeWoEx.She’s hurt.

source_text: 1Hero… Where is the Toma? Where is Daemalius?

structure.raw_value: LiWoCl.1Hero… Where is the Toma? Where is Daemalius?
structure.script_literal: "LiWoCl.1Hero… Where is the Toma? Where is Daemalius?"

source_text: It’s gone… We destroyed it.

structure.raw_value: ErBaEx.It’s gone… We destroyed it.

source_text: The priest is holding off Daemalius. We need to get out of here.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.The priest is holding off Daemalius. We need to get out of here.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.The priest is holding off Daemalius. We need to get out of here."

translation: Kapłan powstrzymuje Daemaliusa. Musimy się stąd wydostać.

source_text: You must destroy the rift… You have to trap Daemalius here.

structure.raw_value: LiWoEx.You must destroy the rift… You have to trap Daemalius here.
structure.script_literal: "LiWoEx.You must destroy the rift… You have to trap Daemalius here."

translation: Musisz zniszczyć szczelinę… Musisz uwięzić tu Daemaliusa.

source_text: Where is Brian?

structure.raw_value: NeWoCl.Where is Brian?

source_text: Father Solomon! We can’t leave without him.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Father Solomon! We can’t leave without him.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Father Solomon! We can’t leave without him."

translation: Ojcze Solomon! Nie możemy go zostawić.

source_text: What are you doing, Mother?

structure.raw_value: D1AnOp^.What are you doing, Mother?

source_text: We’re not going anywhere until you tell us why the Toma Leolo is in pieces!

structure.raw_value: D2AnDe^.We’re not going anywhere until you tell us why the Toma Leolo is in pieces!
structure.script_literal: "D2AnDe^.We’re not going anywhere until you tell us why the Toma Leolo is in pieces!"

translation: Nigdzie nie idziemy, dopóki nie powiesz nam, dlaczego Toma Leolo jest rozbity na kawałki!

source_text: That is not your concern!

structure.raw_value: LiAnOp.That is not your concern!

source_text: It was our ticket out of here and now it’s gone!

structure.raw_value: D3AnEx^.It was our ticket out of here and now it’s gone!
structure.script_literal: "D3AnEx^.It was our ticket out of here and now it’s gone!"

translation: To była nasza przepustka stąd, a teraz przepadła!

source_text: I’m scared!

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl.I’m scared!

source_text: Run! I’ll wait for the priest!

structure.raw_value: HrWoEx.Run! I’ll wait for the priest!

source_text: Shit… I’ll come back!

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Shit… I’ll come back!

source_text: Just go!

structure.raw_value: HrAnEx.Just go!
